text:
Noah: Hey team, first day here! Quick question: who do I ping for ramp access across the stack (service accounts, dataset access, Dedicated seats)? Also want the escalation path if a provisioning ticket stalls for >24h.

Yuki: welcome Noah :tada: Short map: service accounts -> eng-infra, datasets -> data-plat, Dedicated test seats -> eng-platform. For stalled tickets tag `onboard:escalate`.

Samir: hi @Noah - for service accounts include `name`, `project`, and minimal roles. Example paste: ```name: svc-noah-onboard project: dev-dedicated roles: roles/storage.objectViewer,roles/ml.inferenceUser expiry: 7d```

Elena: adding escalation flow: 1) infra triage (48h SLA) -> 2) tag `onboard:escalate` -> 3) product-ops will review and can route to fast-path approvals. If still pending after 24h, ops-manager is looped.

triage-bot: TicketPolicy: onboard-ticket created -> infra-triage. If not actioned within 24h -> notify #product-ops and @ops-manager.

Yuki: we also keep a tiny matrix in the onboarding docs: https://go/redwood/onboard/who-to-ask. I'll DM you the short checklist.

Noah: perfect, saved. One last: is there a canonical subject line for tickets so they get routed quickly?

Samir: yes - use `onboard:<area> <brief>` e.g., `onboard:sa svc-noah-onboard request` and add tags: `onboard,priority:low|high|urgent`. For demos use `onboard:fast-path`.

Noah: thanks everyone! Tagging this for my notes :pray:
